messages:
alexa: Starting a short refresh of the Hello Quickstart to move to token-first auth and tighten the deploy examples (Docker -> Cloud Run).

miguel: I can update the Cloud Run snippet and the one-liner deploy command. Which runtimes do we publish?

alexa: Keep it minimal: node:20 and python:3.11. Also standardize the env var name: REDWOOD_TOKEN (replace REDWOOD_API_KEY).

sam: I'll update the inline code snippets. Can we include a minimal Dockerfile we can rely on for snippet tests?

miguel: Minimal Node Dockerfile for docs: FROM node:20-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production
COPY . .
CMD ["node","index.js"]

alexa: Add a curl sanity-check showing the new header: curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate and a small migration note about how to create demo tokens.

sam: Suggest a demo CLI one-liner: redwoodctl tokens create --title quickstart-demo --output value then export to REDWOOD_TOKEN. Mark demo-only.

miguel: I'll add Cloud Run example: gcloud run deploy quickstart --image gcr.io/$PROJECT/quickstart --set-env-vars REDWOOD_TOKEN=$REDWOOD_TOKEN --platform managed --region us-central1

alexa: Also include two tiny troubleshooting bullets: 1) If you see 401, confirm REDWOOD_TOKEN exported in the same shell or container env. 2) For local demos only, Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *; link to production CORS guide.

sam: Opening PR with updates: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5019. Includes Dockerfile, curl check, Cloud Run snippet, and migration blurb. Assigning @alexa @miguel for review.

preview-bot: Preview built: https://deploy-preview-5019--docs.redwood.ai (expires in 15m)

miguel: I'll smoke-test the Cloud Run flow tomorrow and confirm headers are masked.

alexa: Thanks team  will review tonight and merge if clean.
